name: GraphicBlock
description: a wrapper for charts and graphics with title, description, notes, and ARIA description
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `aria-label` -- provides a full text alternative describing the graphic for screen readers
keyboard: None at the figure level -- interactive children handle their own keyboard interactions
props: `title`: string (optional) -- title displayed above the graphic
`description`: string (optional) -- description text below the title
`notes`: string (optional) -- notes/source text below the graphic
`label`: string (required) -- accessible label describing the graphic for screen readers
